storyCards.fact:
Sade's "Your Love Is King" reached #54 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Your Love Is King" is a song by English band Sade from their debut studio album, Diamond Life (1984).

The song peaked at #54 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Best Of Sade" (1994) — not the song's original release year.
